# Motion Factory Kit

> Code-to-video toolkit for short-form social video. A scene is one HTML file with a draw(ctx, t)
> function; make.mjs renders it frame-exact and adds narration, word-by-word captions, music, sound
> effects and a self-check report. footage.mjs turns a folder of raw footage (UGC, street interviews,
> testimonials) into many finished vertical ads. MIT licensed. Every module can be used on its own.

## Start here
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): the full workflow for a coding agent (works for any agent)
- [docs/MCP.md](docs/MCP.md): MCP server (mcp/server.mjs) exposing every step as tools; .mcp.json wires it up
- [examples/demo](examples/demo/README.md): `npm run demo`, the footage editor end to end with no API keys
- [docs/MODULES.md](docs/MODULES.md): comparison checklist and the pieces that lift out on their own
- [README.md](README.md): overview and setup

## Raw footage to ads
- [docs/EDITOR.md](docs/EDITOR.md): index, edit plans, word-exact cuts, street interviews, street audio, face-following reframe, client review loop
- [footage.mjs](footage.mjs): index / cut / build / review / feedback
- [tools/audio.mjs](tools/audio.mjs): street-audio cleanup and per-speaker levelling (standalone)
- [tools/faces.py](tools/faces.py), [tools/reframe.mjs](tools/reframe.mjs): face track and 9:16 crop that follows it (standalone)
- [tools/review.mjs](tools/review.mjs): client approval page and feedback -> re-cut list (standalone)
- [tools/delivery.mjs](tools/delivery.mjs): delivery sheet for a media buyer (standalone)
- [tools/transcripts.mjs](tools/transcripts.mjs), [tools/transcribe.py](tools/transcribe.py): transcripts from .words.json/.srt/.vtt or local faster-whisper (standalone)
- [tools/plans.mjs](tools/plans.mjs): validate an edit plan against the footage index (standalone)

## Long-form YouTube (16:9, talking footage)
- [docs/LONGFORM.md](docs/LONGFORM.md): script-first videos (script with [[cues]] -> recording aligned -> finished video), footage library + search, plans anchored to words, inserts (animation, B-roll, stock, outside clips), Premiere XML
- [longform.mjs](longform.mjs): script / from-script / index / search / words / check / stock / pull / build / demo
- [tools/longform/](tools/longform/): library (index+search), plan (word-exact cuts, anchors), build (assembly, mix), premiere (FCP7 XML), stock (Pexels)
- [scenes/longform/](scenes/longform/): 16:9 animation starters (stat, quote, term, compare, steps, bars, backdrop; poker set: superposition, collapse, deception)

- [scenes/longform/3d/](scenes/longform/3d/): three.js scenes (kit3d.js stage; table3d, stacks3d), rendered by tools/longform/render3d.mjs through headless Chrome

## Building videos
- [docs/TEMPLATES.md](docs/TEMPLATES.md): 12 data-driven ad and organic formats
- [docs/BLOCKS.md](docs/BLOCKS.md): 32 canvas blocks (UGC, street-interview overlays, explainer UI)
- [docs/HIGGSFIELD.md](docs/HIGGSFIELD.md): AI-generated clips
- [docs/LANGUAGES.md](docs/LANGUAGES.md): translated and dubbed versions
- [design/DESIGN.md](design/DESIGN.md): the visual rules
